name: YouTube

offers.label: Play all
offers.description: Plays the queue from its oldest video: what was put on it first plays first, and the rest

offers.label: Play
offers.description: Plays the video, whether or not it was played before: the session takes it as its one item,

offers.label: Session
offers.description: The session this app plays through: the one it has, or one made now. It is kept both in

offers.label: Delete history
offers.description: Deletes the person's own watch history, and the entries carried from before it recorded

offers.label: Autoplay next video
offers.description: Each of these keeps one of the person's own playback preferences: the record is theirs, made

offers.label: Preferred quality
offers.description: The tallest picture the person wants, as YouTube names it; `auto` takes the best that fits.

offers.label: Skip sponsor segments
offers.description: Whether the player skips the segments SponsorBlock marks, as they play.

offers.label: Community titles and pictures
offers.description: Whether a video shows the community's title and picture where DeArrow has them.

offers.label: Dislike counts
offers.description: Whether a video shows how many people disliked it, as Return YouTube Dislike estimates it.

offers.label: Show comments
offers.description: Whether a video's page shows its comments.

offers.label: Playback speed
offers.description: How fast the person watches: every video here starts at this speed, on every device.

offers.label: Pair a Grayjay device
offers.description: Pairs a Grayjay device from the invite its Sync screen shows. The invite carries where the

offers.label: Sync now
offers.description: Exchanges with every approved device now: reads the subscriptions and watch history Grayjay

offers.label: Keep paired
offers.description: Keeps the device a pairing made, waiting for the person's approval: the fingerprint beside

offers.label: Keep exchange
offers.description: Keeps what an exchange came to: how each device stands, the subscriptions the other apps

offers.label: Search
offers.description: Searches YouTube: the service answers with channels, playlists and videos, written where the

offers.label: Filter the search
offers.description: Narrows the search to the kinds the person chose: `all`, `video`, `channel` or `playlist`.

offers.label: Filter by length
offers.description: Narrows the search to how long its videos run: `any`, `short`, `medium` or `long`.

offers.label: Filter by date
offers.description: Narrows the search to how recent its results are: `any`, `hour`, `today`, `week`, `month` or

offers.label: Leave search
offers.description: Leaves the search the feed is showing for the place the person chose: the results stay where

offers.label: Refresh
offers.description: Asks the service for the newest videos of each subscribed channel: what the subscriptions feed

offers.label: Refresh trending
offers.description: Asks the service for the videos it lists as trending.

offers.label: Open link
offers.description: Opens a link of the scheme this client claims: the video (`tube:watch?v=<key>`), channel
